method.branches: if, ternary, loops, catch, non-default case, &&, ||, ??. Nested functions have independent records; their branches are excluded from the parent count.
method.ranking: branches * 4 + lines / 8 + parameters; triage heuristic, not cyclomatic complexity

scope.inventory: all files under src/** and scripts/**

baseline.source: git HEAD restored via TypeScript API virtual filesystem
